news.title: The Scope and Nature of the U.S.-China Competition
news.summary_en: This is the first of several reports in a RAND study on the U.S.-China competition. The authors provide a framework for evaluating the character and status of that competition and give insight into how the United States can gain strategic leverage.

news.title: Adversarial artificial intelligence: Implications of strategic stability attacks on military AI systems
news.summary_en: As military AI use grows, attacks that disrupt or deny AI systems could threaten strategic stability. This study examines risks to military and critical infrastructure systems, and recommends measures to reduce attacks and their impact globally.

news.title: Bringing Directed Energy Weapons Into Focus: Integrating Emerging Capabilities Into NATO Air Defence
news.summary_en: This article examines the potential contribution of Directed Energy Weapons to NATO air defence.

news.title: Private Equity Ownership and Artificial Intelligence Adoption by Hospitals in the United States
news.summary_en: We examined the association between private equity hospital ownership and the likelihood of artificial intelligence technology adoption.

news.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Use and Adolescent Mental Health
news.summary_en: This paper synthesizes recent literature on the relationships between GenAI use and adolescents’ mental health, with particular attention to problematic use and psychiatric vulnerabilities.

news.title: From Policy to Practice: How State Policies Relate to Public Pre-K Teachers’ Curriculum Use
news.summary_en: We investigated the role that state policies related to preschool curriculum play in public school pre-K teachers’ reported curricula use across the United States.
